section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Testing assumptions', describes the process of inspecting the distributional properties of a scale to examine the normality of its total scores. It specifies that skewness and kurtosis values between –2 and +2 were considered acceptable for normal univariate distribution.
section_summary.evidence_source: 2.7.1 Testing assumptions Distributional properties of the scale were inspected to examine the normality of the total scores. Skewness and kurtosis values between –2 and +2 were assumed to indicate an acceptable range to prove normal univariate distribution (George & Mallery, 2010).
